scope: Read-only contract check for one substantially different local surface reconstruction approach. No candidate or fit was built; accepted source mesh and prior diagnostic artifacts were not modified.

reviewed_owner_implementations.observed_contract: Requires a matched complete surface report/query receipt and the complete 185-bank inventory. Produces exact-union-exit target points attached to source face rows and barycentric weights; it does not generate or remesh connected triangles.

reconstruct_connected_layers offsets existing outer-surface vertices along their oriented normals and harmonically fits fixed layer boundaries. It consumes existing faces, has no bone distance-field input, and does not create a new surface topology.

Provides exact first-outward-exit/plane queries and source-outward direction mapping. It expects precomputed generated-node parent tetra/barycentric ancestry for reference fields; it does not build a signed-distance volume or offset skin mesh.

Quality-controls TetGen tetrahedra within a closed pre-existing tetrahedral cavity, preserves its exact input cavity boundary, and maps new nodes to parent cavity tetrahedra/barycentrics. Its pinned input is a different global interior field candidate; it does not generate a skin patch with source-face ancestry from the current surface.

obstacle: The reviewed owner tools provide point exit targets, vertex normal offsets on existing faces, and volumetric tetrahedral cavity remeshing. None accepts the current 115/118 crossing skin patch plus the bone triangles and returns a connected, quality-controlled outer-surface patch whose 47 fixed boundary edges are preserved and whose new vertices/faces carry source skin face/barycentric ancestry. The current candidate contains only points and surface faces, with no matched local tet cavity or signed-distance volume. Reusing the volumetric remesher would require a new bone-aware offset/cavity construction and a new skin ancestry bridge; constructing those here would introduce the framework the bounded task excludes.
next_safe_change: Provide or build an owner-approved local offset-surface constructor for bank 115/118 that consumes the complete typed bone surface, preserves the 47-edge source patch boundary, emits well-shaped Float32 triangles, and records source candidate face/barycentric ancestry for every new vertex. Then screen the private patch with exact local bone, self, and parent-shape gates.
